text: ふう…　ありがとう　だいぶ　ラクに　なった　みたいだ　…なになに　なんだ　ひでんの　わざを　みに　きたのか　げんきな　ときなら　じまんの　いあいぎりを　みせるんだがなあ…　そうだ！

structure.jp: だいぶ　ラクに　なった　みたいだ
structure.en: I seem to feel a lot better

structure.jp: ひでんの　わざを　みに　きたのか
structure.en: you came to see my secret technique?

structure.jp: げんきな　ときなら
じまんの　いあいぎりを　みせるんだがなあ…
structure.en: I'd show you my prized Cut, but...

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.explanation: みたいだ after a statement means 'it seems that', the speaker's own impression. ラクに なった みたいだ = 'I seem to have gotten better'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb stem plus に before a going or coming verb says what you come there to do. みに きた = 'came to see'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.span: げんきな　ときなら
patterns.explanation: なら means 'if it were', setting up a situation that may not be true. げんきな ときなら = 'if it were a time when I was well'.
